name: Four Seasons Hotel Beirut
positioning: Four Seasons hotel in Beirut's historical downtown, beside the Zaitunay Bay marina; temporarily closed for restoration
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Beirut base near the souks and Martyr's Square
Guests planning ahead for the reopening

facts.text: The hotel is at 1418 Professor Wafic Sinno Avenue.
The hotel is located beside the Zaitunay Bay marina.
The hotel is located in the heart of Beirut's historical downtown.
Beirut souks and Martyr's Square are an easy walk from the hotel.
The interior designer is Pierre-Yves Rochon.
The Grill exclusively serves Wagyu and USDA Prime-Aged beef.
The hotel offers panoramic vistas across the capital, Mediterranean Sea and snow-capped Lebanese mountains.

highlights.text: The hotel has a seasonal outdoor pool set 26 storeys above Beirut.
Level 26 is described as Beirut's highest rooftop bar & lounge.
Arabesque is a third-floor terrace lounge with a wide selection of shisha flavours.
The Bar is where guests can share cognac and cigars.
The spa has a couple's suite with private whirlpool, steam and shower facilities.

considerations.text: The hotel has embarked on a restoration project and will be temporarily closed.
The hotel's website lists the reopening as Summer 2027.
The Grill, The Lobby Lounge, The Bar & Lounge, Arabesque and Level 26 are each marked temporarily closed.
Four Seasons lists 3 new restaurants and lounge among the hotel's essentials.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
